hist.title: History
hist.search.label: Search history
hist.status.label: Status
hist.list.label: History entries
hist.run.error: The run's requests could not be loaded. {detail}
hist.run.noMatch: No requests in this run match the filters.
hist.more.error: More entries could not be loaded.
hist.state.noResults.title: Nothing matches
hist.state.noResults.body: Try other words, or widen the filters.
hist.state.noSelection.title: Select an entry to see the stored request and response
hist.state.noSelection.body: Use the arrow keys in the list to move between entries.
hist.state.loadError.title: History could not be loaded
hist.state.loadError.body: The core answered: {detail}. Your entries are not deleted.
hist.state.reloadError: History could not be refreshed: {detail}. The list below may be out of date.
hist.origin.agentGone: From a chat that was deleted
hist.action.run.noSnapshot: This entry did not keep the request it sent (it was over 256 KiB), so it cannot be sent again. Open it as a draft to rebuild it from the URL.
hist.viewer.note: This is the stored response. Run again sends a new request.
hist.toast.copied: Copied cURL. Variables are not expanded. Credentials are replaced.
hist.clear.title: Clear all history?
hist.clear.body.one: Deletes the {count} entry in {workspace} for good. You confirm first. There is no Undo.
hist.clear.body.other: Deletes all {count} entries in {workspace} for good. You confirm first. There is no Undo.
hist.clearFiltered.title: Clear filtered entries?
hist.clearFiltered.body.one: Deletes {count} entry that matches the filters for good. Other entries stay. There is no Undo.
hist.clearFiltered.body.other: Deletes {count} entries that match the filters for good. Other entries stay. There is no Undo.
hist.guard.title: Send {method} {path} to {env}?
hist.guard.body: {env} asks you to confirm before it sends. This sends a new request.
hist.filter.label: Filter history
hist.chips.label: Active filters
hist.state.never.title: This workspace has no entries yet
hist.state.never.body: Sends from requests, flows, mocks and agents land here.
hist.state.range.title: No entries in this time range
hist.state.range.body: This workspace has {count} entries in all.
hist.summary.error: The list could not be refreshed
hist.notice.hidden: The new entry is hidden by the current filters. It is still shown in the viewer.
hist.notice.unsaved: This response was not saved to history
hist.export.title: Export as HAR
hist.export.fact.secrets: Values such as Authorization, Cookie and api_key are replaced with placeholders, the same rules as Copy as cURL.
hist.export.fact.body: Response bodies are the previews History stored (at most 16 KiB each); a cut one says so in its comment.
hist.export.fact.manifest: The file ends with the entry count and a checksum, so an edited file can be told apart.
hist.export.failed: Export failed: {reason} No file was written.
